The AI Factory, From Above: Every Building, Machine and Team on One Site Plan

Fly over a one-campus AI factory and look down. The grid connection and on-site power, the switchgear and batteries, the cooling plant and water, two data halls full of liquid-cooled racks, the network core, the storage hall, the control room, the loading dock and the people who run it are all on one plan. Tap anything to see what it does, a typical figure, who runs it and every article on this site that covers it. Switch to the software view to see which part of the AI software stack runs where.

⚠️ A reference design, not a real site. This plan is our illustration of a typical liquid-cooled AI campus, assembled from the case studies and explainers on this site. Real sites differ widely in layout, power source and cooling. Figures marked "typical" are rounded ranges or examples taken from the linked articles; the scale selector and the request animation are simplified models.
